metadata.title: A nonarithmetic lattice from a mirror in the Couwenberg-Heckman-Looijenga construction
metadata.abstract: We prove that the stabilizer of a reflection mirror of the Couwenberg-Heckman-Looijenga lattice $\mathcal{C}(G_{29},3)$ induces a nonarithmetic lattice in $\operatorname{PU}(2,1)$. This lattice is not commensurable with any Deligne-Mostow lattice in $\operatorname{PU}(2,1)$ or any lattice in the twenty-two nonarithmetic classes listed by Deraux, Parker and Paupert.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明Couwenberg–Heckman–Looijenga格C(G₂₉,3)的一面反射镜稳定子在PU(2,1)中诱导非算术格；并证明它既不与Deligne–Mostow格可公度，也不属于Deraux–Parker–Paupert所列22个非算术可公度类。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供超出两组已知列表的复双曲二维非算术格类。
analysis.limitations: 这是特定稳定子的构造及类区分，不是PU(2,1)所有非算术格的完整分类。摘要未给不变量、协体积或具体商的几何描述。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第15页致谢明确AI模型特别ChatGPT帮助探索主题及准备论文；可确认研究探索，稿件准备的具体方式未细分，不把关键非算术格构造或证明归于模型。
